SELECT planes_generados.id AS planes_generados_id, planes_generados.fecha_generacion AS planes_generados_fecha_generacion, planes_generados.kcal_objetivo AS planes_generados_kcal_objetivo, planes_generados.proteina_g AS planes_generados_proteina_g, planes_generados.carbs_g AS planes_generados_carbs_g, planes_generados.grasa_g AS planes_generados_grasa_g, planes_generados.tipo_plan AS planes_generados_tipo_plan, planes_generados.pdf_object_id AS planes_generados_pdf_object_id, planes_generados.ruta_pdf AS planes_generados_ruta_pdf 
FROM planes_generados JOIN clientes ON clientes.id_cliente = planes_generados.id_cliente 
WHERE planes_generados.gym_id = ? AND clientes.gym_id = ? AND planes_generados.deleted_at IS NULL AND clientes.deleted_at IS NULL AND planes_generados.id_cliente = ? ORDER BY planes_generados.fecha_generacion DESC NULLS LAST, planes_generados.id DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
